answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Only 200 seats are sold per epoch by sealed bid; each winner locks 60 credits in a vault for 20 epochs, released over that horizon so a seat cannot be flipped fast. An attacker wanting 1000 seats must lock 60000 credits, while one honest agent pays 60 credits once. A seat idle or resold falls off the ledge of eligibility and its bond is burned. Honest agents recover their bid and earn undiluted rewards.
